# Spacious 1-room apartment with balcony and cellar in Púchov

> RealityZopos offers for sale a spacious 1-room apartment on the 1st floor of an apartment building on 1. mája street in Púchov. The apartment has a total area of 52 m², with a balcony of 1.5 m² and a cellar of 8 m². The apartment consists of a living room, kitchen, hallway, bathroom with WC, and a practical pantry providing ample storage space.
